text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The report responds to a request from Councillor Neethan Shan to review parking regulations along the Nightstar Road Lanes and the Staines Road Lanes to determine if the removal of parking regulations on one side of these lanes is justified.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Directed the General Manager, Transportation Services to remove the No Parking Anytime signs on the southwest and southeast sides of the Nightstar Road Lane west and south of Wharnsby Drive, between Polarlights Way and Wharnsby Drive. 2. Directed the General Manager, Transportation Services to remove the No Parking Anytime signs on the northwest and southwest sides of the Nightstar Road Lane east and south of Wharnsby Drive, between Wharnsby Drive and Flycatcher Avenue. 3. Directed the General Manager, Transportation Services to remove the No Parking Anytime signs on the east and south sides of the Staines Road Lane south of Wharnsby Drive, between Flycatcher Avenue and Wharnsby Drive. 4.
